title: 2026 season opener includes potential Super Bowl rematch

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 2026 season opener includes potential Super Bowl rematch
sources.description: When the 2026 regular season begins on the Thursday night after Labor Day (there's a chance it'll start a day or two earlier given the long trip the 49ers and Rams will make to Australia), the Seahawks will be hosting the game and hanging their newest banner.
